title: RSS Reader
summary: A reader for RSS and Atom text feeds, with a catalog of about 260 feeds.
description: Pin feeds from the catalog, by country and topic, or add any site by its address. Read articles full screen with their pictures, in the text size you choose; save articles for offline reading, export or import your favorites as OPML. Only the feeds are fetched, nothing is sent anywhere else. Needs the network to update the feeds; what was fetched stays readable offline. Works upright in PDA mode.
